who: Don Luis P. Marquez and *** Dona MERCEDES LERENA ***, feligresa de la *** CATEDRAL ***
the impediment, as the register states i: Dispensed *** two conciliar banns *** - a routine dispensation of notice, not of kinship
what it means: A Lerena woman in the Montevideo CATHEDRAL parish, which is the trunk this archive works. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** SERAPIO FERNANDEZ (hijo) *** and *** Dona ANTONINA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** SECOND GRADE of consanguinity by the EQUAL lateral line ***
what it means: *** FIRST COUSINS. *** And the groom is a *** FERNANDEZ *** - the surname of Sancho Llerena's wife Maria Fernandez and of Avelino Lerena Fernandez. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** MAXIMO PELAEZ *** and *** Dona MARIA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** THIRD GRADE of consanguinity WITH ATTINGENCY TO THE SECOND, by the UNEQUAL lateral line ***
what it means: *** TWO LERENA WOMEN OF TRINIDAD DISPENSED IN ONE SITTING ***, one to a Fernandez and one to a *** PELAEZ ***. "With attingency to the second" means two separate blood paths at once. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** JUAN LERENA *** and *** Dona EDUVIGES PELAEZ ***, feligresa de *** MERCEDES ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** SECOND GRADE equal lateral AND THIRD GRADE equal lateral, both accumulated *** - dispensed *** de oficio ***, that is free, which the register reserves for the poor
what it means: *** FIRST COUSINS AND SECOND COUSINS AT ONCE. *** And a THIRD Lerena-Pelaez union. *** This archive already holds BERNABE LERENA married to CASIMIRA PELAEZ at Trinidad *** - see data/lerena-pelaez-trinidad.tsv. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** ADOLFO CORDERO *** and *** Dona ZELMIRA CARLOTA LERENA ***, feligresa de la *** METROPOLITANA ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** THIRD GRADE with attingency to the SECOND, unequal lateral line ***
what it means: *** THIS IS A WOMAN THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HAS, AND ONCE WROTE OFF. *** Zelmira Carlota Lerena Larriera was tested on 14 September and concluded "not ours", and that conclusion was itself corrected. *** Here is her marriage, and it proves she married a blood relative *** - which is a fact about her ancestry, not merely her life.

who: Don Guillermo [Repetto?] and *** Dona MARIA ELENA LERENA ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** RELIGION MIXTA *** - the impediment of mixed religion
what it means: *** ONE OF THE TWO PARTIES WAS NOT CATHOLIC. *** In a family this archive has only ever met in Catholic registers, that is worth knowing. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** VITALINO GREGORIO PELAEZ *** and *** Dona FLORINDA JUANA LERENA ***, feligresa de *** TRINIDAD ***
the impediment, as the register states i: *** THIRD GRADE of consanguinity by the EQUAL lateral line ***
what it means: *** SECOND COUSINS, and a FOURTH Lerena-Pelaez union - the second of them explicitly at TRINIDAD. *** *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** EDUARDO LERENA *** and Dona Maria Mercedes Razzello, feligresa de *** LAS PIEDRAS ***
what it means: A Lerena man at Las Piedras, Canelones - the department Sancho married in. *** New to this register. ***

who: Don *** JUAN CARLOS GONZALEZ LERENA *** and Dona Concepcion Petrona Urbano, feligresa del *** CORDON ***
what it means: *** FOUND 8 OCTOBER AND SET ASIDE ON THE SURNAME ORDER *** - Gonzalez from his father, Lerena from his mother, so his children would be Gonzalez. Kept here so the nine entries are one list.
